about_the_game:
Get a first taste of Escape Simulator 2 – the sequel to best-selling escape room game. In this free demo, you’ll explore:

Dracula’s Courtyard

Step into the eerie courtyard of Dracula’s Castle, uncover clues, and solve puzzles to unlock the gates. It’s the first room in one of the full game’s three major themes.

The New Lobby

A central hub where you can customize your character, check out collectibles, and meet up with friends for multiplayer.

Tutorial Room

New to the series? Learn the basics of movement, interaction, and puzzle-solving in a quick and fun intro room.

What to Expect in the Full Game

Escape Simulator 2 builds on everything players loved from the first game – and makes it bigger, better, and more immersive:

  • 12 handcrafted escape rooms (and many more after the release)

  • Play solo or with up to 8-player in an online co-op

  • Room Editor 2.0 – create your own escape rooms

  • Steam Workshop support

  • Full voice and text chat support

  • Character customization

  • 10+ supported languages

  • Gamepad & Steam Deck support

  • Tokens, secrets and collectibles

With more content coming after release.

We’d love your feedback

We’d love your feedback – write a review, join our Discord, or email us...and don’t forget to wishlist the full game!
